thread.title: Best Buy Stock Rises On Third-Quarter Earnings | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Best Buy Stock Rises On Third-Quarter Earnings | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Consumer electronics retailer Best Buy ( BBY ) on Tuesday beat Wall Street's targets for its fiscal third quarter. But it came up short with its holiday-quarter outlook. Best Buy stock fell in early trading, then rebounded for a modest gain.
X Richfield, Minn.-based Best Buy earned an adjusted 93 cents a share on sales of $9.59 billion in the quarter ended Nov. 3. Analysts expected it to earn 85 cents a share on sales of $9.56 billion. On a year-over-year basis, earnings per share rose 19% while sales climbed 3%.
For the critical holiday shopping season, Best Buy expects same-store sales growth to be flat to up 3%. It guided to earnings per share of $2.53 on sales of $14.6 billion in the fourth quarter. That's based on the midpoint of its guidance.
Projections For Best Buy Stock Wall Street was modeling Best Buy to earn $2.58 a share, up 7%, on sales of $14.68 billion, down 4%, in its fiscal fourth quarter. However, the company's fiscal fourth quarter last year had an extra week compared with the same quarter this year. That added about $760 million in revenue and 20 cents a share in earnings to the year-ago quarter.

Best Buy stock fell earlier this month after rival Amazon.com ( AMZN ) signed a deal with Apple ( AAPL ). The deal expands the selection of Apple products that Amazon sells on its sites worldwide, including iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches.
Best Buy Shakes Off Amazon-Apple Deal Apple remains a key vendor partner for Best Buy, Chief Executive Hubert Joly said on a conference call with analysts.
"We've built over the years a very unique experience selling Apple products," Joly said. Best Buy has 900 Apple Stores within its locations. "They do a great job of showcasing the products and services," Joly said.
Apple's deal with Amazon will massively reduce the number of third-party sellers of Apple products on Amazon's e-commerce platform, Joly said. The net effect of that arrangement on Best Buy's business is still unclear, he added.
"Our team just delivered another strong quarter with 4.3% comparable sales growth and better-than-expected earnings growth," Joly said in a news release .
He added, "The holiday season is here, and our team has put together a best-in-class assortment, prepared an amazing set of deals, and ensured we have great inventory availability across all the product categories we carry."
Big Sales Drivers At U.S. Stores At its U.S. stores, sales drivers in the third quarter included mobile phones, gaming, appliances, wearables, headphones and smart home devices. Tablet computers were a notably weak category.
Best Buy reported domestic online sales of $1.21 billion in the third quarter, up 12.6%. It noted improvements in conversion rates and improved traffic.
This holiday season Best Buy has many "exciting products" to offer consumers, Joly said.
"Gaming is going to be particularly hot," he said. Nintendo ( NTDOY ) is promoting its "Super Smash Bros. Ultimate" game for the Nintendo Switch console. Plus, Activision Blizzard ( ATVI ) has "Call of Duty: Black Ops 4" and Take-Two Interactive Software ( TTWO ) has "Red Dead Redemption 2," he said.
"TVs continue to be a big item with people moving to larger screens and smart TVs," Joly said.
Other gadgets likely to be big sellers include streaming devices, voice-assistant speakers with screens, smartphones, health trackers, kitchen appliances and security products like video doorbells, he said.
